Project 007 · 2025 · Startup Concept

Ration

Brand Strategy, Identity & App UI/UX · Food-Delivery Concept, Nigeria
Timeline
2025
Engagement
Startup concept engagement
Deliverables
10 deliverable types

Ration is a startup concept intended for Nigeria. It is not a launched food-delivery service.

The Problem

It needed a complete brand identity and app UI/UX direction.

The Strategic Move

Stand out from common food-delivery visual conventions with a deep blue-grey and orange system. Deep blue-grey gives a dependable base; orange adds appetite, momentum, and contrast. The R monogram contains a strategically placed spoon and fork to signal "ready to eat."

What We Built
  • Brand strategy
  • Competitor research
  • Naming and tagline direction
  • Brand voice and core values
  • Logo and spoon-and-fork R monogram
  • Visual identity
  • Colour and typography system
  • Brand guidelines
  • App UI/UX
  • One social-media launch asset
Outcome

Brand design and app UI/UX were completed as a launch-ready concept foundation.

Primary, Deep Blue-Gray#404E5C
Secondary, Beige / Off-White#F5F5DC
Accent, Warm Orange-Red#FF4D00

The mark started as research, not sketches: a competitor audit across the usual delivery apps, then colour psychology testing before blue-gray was chosen over the category's usual red and yellow, on purpose, to read as dependable rather than loud.

The Mark

A wordmark with a lettermark 'R' that hides a spoon and fork in its counter. Deep Blue-Gray is the official colour; the warm orange only appears as an accent or on dark and light contrast backgrounds.

Brand Guideline

The full guideline: logo construction, an accessibility-checked colour system, and a type pairing of Almarena Neue for headings with Nunito Sans for body copy.

Prelaunch

The first public post: a coming-soon announcement built to work as a single square before the app, or the rest of the identity, existed anywhere else.
